## Objective
- Finish the existing LAST PATROL tactical game so it is complete and playable without clarification.

## Requirements
- Build on or modify the existing game; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treat the existing LAST PATROL game as the project to finish; it includes campaign, loadout, squad management, and turn-based combat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed attack-target highlighting and the dynamic range label to follow the selected soldier’s weapon range.
- Implemented the heavy recruit’s close-range damage bonus, HOLD’s defense brace, and the medic’s once-per-mission nearby heal.
- Added a data-URL favicon to prevent `/favicon.ico` 404s.
- Tested loadout, faction selection, recruiting, movement, HOLD, enemy turns, and a combat victory with campaign progression in Chromium.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg` at 1280×900; combat cleared successfully and campaign advanced to `02 / 03`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; browser run reported no page errors.

### Active
- (none)

- (none)

## Next Move
1. Briefly report completion and note any reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, screens, loadout, squad, combat, and campaign logic.
- `index.html`: Game screens, controls, and dynamic combat range label.
- `style.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Latest inspected JPEG screenshot of the command HQ.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3002/`; the browser test reset local storage and then completed the first mission.
